Method of Attack: Distributed through phishing emails with attached Word or Excel documents containing malicious macros
Tricks users into enabling macros that download the Emotet malware
Steals victims' emails for reply-chain attacks
Installs other malware leading to Conti ransomware attacks
Downloads additional payloads such as Cobalt Strike and SystemBC remote access Trojan
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with password-protected zip or HTML attachments containing malicious Excel files
Indicators of Compromise: Emails impersonating IRS.gov with subjects like 'IRS Tax Forms W-9', 'Incorrect Form Selection', 'INCOME TAX RETURN 2021'
Password-protected zip attachments containing 'W-9 form.xslm' Excel files
Use of password '24509' for zip files
